none: PAS NLM-7A34C7: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II from Preston
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate: Posthumous issue for Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Bust radiate right. Obverse inscription: DIVO CLAVDIO. Reverse description: Eagle standing left head facing right. Reverse inscription: [CONSECR]ATIO. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 20.2mm, Weight: 2.14gms, die axis: 12
